Say goodbye to monolithic AI runners: DeepSeek's new harness brings true modularity to agent execution through an 'Everything is a Plugin' architecture. 🤖🔥

Tired of rigid, monolithic orchestration frameworks that lock you into a single way of building AI agents? 

Meet DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), an open-source agent harness designed to coordinate, execute, and scale AI agents through a highly modular and extensible architecture. 

✨ Key Features:
• Everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis, enforcing strict spatiotemporal composability for plugins and agent behaviors.
• Out-of-the-box local Web UI support accessible via `npx` or source builds for interactive agent management and monitoring.
• Rapidly iterating developer preview supporting custom ecosystem expansions via the `dsh-plugin` community topic.
• Built-in handling of environment contexts (local vs. SSH) for seamless server-to-browser mapping.

💡 Why AI Engineers & Devs Love It:
Build complex AI agent systems without getting locked into rigid orchestration frameworks. By leveraging the Cordis-powered plugin model, your team can independently develop, test, and swap out agent capabilities, memory modules, and tool execution environments—drastically reducing technical debt in rapidly evolving AI codebases.

Whether you are building and debugging modular AI coding agents with custom toolsets and UI extensions, or deploying extensible LLM agent backends that require dynamic plugin loading in remote headless or SSH environments, `dsh` has you covered.

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

👇 How are you currently orchestrating your AI agents? Drop a comment below and let's discuss! Don't forget to clone the repo and start building your custom plugins today.

Tired of stateless AI assistants? Hermes Agent brings a self-improving closed learning loop, multi-platform messaging, and zero-cost serverless isolation straight to your terminal and chat apps. 🚀

Most AI coding assistants suffer from a major limitation: they are stateless and isolated, forgetting context the moment a session ends and trapping you in endless re-prompting. 

Hermes Agent solves this by providing a full-featured, self-improving autonomous agent framework. It bridges local execution, multi-platform chat gateways, and flexible cloud terminal backends while maintaining a closed learning loop that remembers context, auto-creates and refines skills, and adapts to you across sessions.

🔥 Key Features:
• Closed Learning Loop & Autonomous Skill Creation: Automatically generates and refines custom skills from task execution, leverages agent-curated memory, and integrates Honcho dialectic user modeling for cross-session persona recall.
• Multi-Platform Messaging Gateway: Operates seamlessly across Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI from a single process, supporting cross-platform continuity and voice memo transcription.
• Flexible Serverless & Local Terminal Backends: Runs across local machines, Docker, SSH, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox, allowing environments to hibernate when idle for minimal cost.
• Model-Agnostic with Nous Portal Integration: Compatible with any LLM provider via simple model switching or unified through the Nous Portal for aggregated API, web search, text-to-speech, and cloud browser services.

Whether you want to deploy an autonomous personal DevOps assistant on a $5 VPS that runs scheduled backups and reports to Telegram, or build custom coding workflows that persist across sessions without context bloat, Hermes Agent has you covered. 

👉 Check out the repo and start building:
https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

✨ Transform a single AI text prompt into an interactive, 3D holographic trading card with editable Blender assets and a web-ready Three.js viewer!

Building interactive 3D assets from generative AI usually means stitching together messy manual workflows, uncoordinated textures, and painful DCC tool setups. 

Holo Card Studio bridges generative AI intent with localized 3D rendering pipelines by acting as a Codex Skill. It automates the entire asset creation lifecycle—from generating layered textures to assembling parametric Blender scenes with holographic shaders and compiling everything into an interactive Three.js web app.

🔥 Key Features:
• Multi-Layered Parallax & Holographic Shaders: Deconstructs 2D inputs into spatial layers with iridescent rainbow foils, Voronoi starfields, and gold borders.
• Automated Blender Pipeline: Locally provisions portable Blender binaries, orchestrating headless builds and generating fully editable .blend files.
• Dual Rendering Modes: Supports single-image holographic cards and advanced dual-image lenticular flip-flop cards via perspective-tracking UV formulas.
• Zero-Config Web Delivery: Bundles outputs into a responsive local web viewer with mouse tilt, touch control, card-flipping, and dynamic parameter adjustments.

💡 Why developers love it:
Use this as a reference architecture for chaining generative AI workflows with local deterministic execution environments like Python, headless Blender, and Three.js. It's the ultimate toolkit for building programmatic indie game collectible cards or dynamic promotional product reveals.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/EverettFish/holo-card-studio

Track how AI models describe your product, who they recommend, and which sources they cite with NiubiGEO! 🚀

Traditional SEO is no longer enough. As users increasingly turn to LLMs and AI assistants instead of traditional search engines to discover software, how does your product show up in the age of AI discovery? 

NiubiGEO is an open-source utility designed to solve the emerging challenge of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It helps you track brand visibility, descriptions, competitor associations, and source citations across different LLMs and search engines.

Key Features Built for Developers & Growth Engineers:
🔍 Multi-Model Comparison: Select and query multiple OpenRouter models concurrently, configuring native web search modes independently per model.
🤖 Keyword & Brand-Agnostic Testing: Test keyword scenarios without explicitly naming your target brand to see unprompted recommendations and competitor visibility.
📊 Evidence & Citation Tracking: Isolate and inspect original model responses, text locations, provider citations, and ordinary answer URLs with historical audit logs.
⏰ Scheduled Monitoring: Run automated, repeated measurements via a dedicated monitoring worker to establish historical tracking of AI visibility changes.

Whether you want to audit how different LLMs summarize your documentation or run scheduled GEO competitor tracking reports to see which alternative tools AI models recommend in your niche, NiubiGEO can be self-hosted easily via Docker.

👉 Check it out on GitHub and start auditing your AI presence today:

Transform your coding agent into an expert video editor with 40 battle-tested, local-first FFmpeg tools and a self-producing execution contract. 🎬🤖

We’ve all been there: wasting hours playing the frustrating command-line guessing game, trying to construct brittle FFmpeg filter graphs and debugging obscure flags just to trim a video or normalize audio. 

Enter ffmpeg-skill. It solves this by packaging complex FFmpeg and FFprobe workflows into clean, typed, agent-ready tools designed specifically for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It runs entirely locally via Python and the command line with zero cloud dependencies or API keys.

✨ Key Features:
• Self-Producing Execution Contract (SPEC): Tool input schemas are dynamically derived at runtime directly from Python's argparse parser, ensuring zero drift between CLI flags and agent tooling.
• 40 Structured, Shell-Free Tools: Handle cutting, joining, silence removal, aspect-ratio fitting, karaoke captions, HDR-to-SDR conversion, and loudness normalization via typed arguments instead of unsafe shell strings.
• Comprehensive Verification Loop: Every job finishes with automated validation, including output probing and visual inspection via contact sheets to guarantee results match intent.
• Universal MCP Support: Works as a standalone local engine or exposes its entire toolkit over Model Context Protocol (MCP) using standard stdio JSON-RPC.

Whether you are building automated CI/CD media validation pipelines or letting your AI assistant automatically slice raw footage for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, this utility eliminates trial-and-error completely. 🚀

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
